categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在LLM能力增强与评测，涵盖长上下文、世界模型校准、Agent基准和多智能体协同进化。

articles.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
articles.zh: LongZero：从零数据提升LLM的长上下文推理能力
articles.summary: 如果你正为长上下文训练数据难造发愁，这套方法不依赖真实长文本也能把长文推理能力练出来，但别指望它能替代真实分布的数据。
articles.author: Zhennan Wan, Jianfei Chen
articles.body: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.
articles.bodyZh: 强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）是提升大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）长上下文推理能力的一条好路子，但它得有又长、又多样、又有挑战性、还能验证的训练数据。人工标注这类数据很贵，自然产生的数据又太少，撑不起强化学习；现有的合成方法还得靠外部语料库（external corpora）或者更强的教师模型（teacher models），可模型越训越强，这些东西就越难搞到。最近，零数据强化学习（RL from zero data）——也就是让模型从自己提出的任务里学习——表现很猛，但现有方法主要盯着短上下文任务。所以，我们提出了 LongZero：一个让大语言模型不靠任何外部数据，也能自己提升长上下文推理能力的方法。LongZero 不是直接在现有文档上出题和写答案，而是先让模型用紧凑的结构化形式，把问题、答案和支撑证据一起合成出来，然后再单独把证据扩展成长长的多文档上下文。LongZero 把这些自己写的多跳推理任务（multi-hop reasoning tasks）和自己写的多轮检索任务（multi-round retrieval tasks）结合起来，用 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）来训练模型。我们在两个大语言模型上、用五个长上下文推理基准测试（benchmarks）评估 LongZero，并和用外部语料库合成数据做强化学习的方法进行比较。实验结果显示，LongZero 能泛化到真实任务上，而且比两个基线方法都强，这说明它是一条可行、也很有前景的路子，能帮助大语言模型提升长上下文推理能力。

articles.title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
articles.zh: 在关键处多想：面向序列推荐的物品级自适应递归
articles.summary: 如果你做推荐系统，这篇提醒你别对所有物品一视同仁地堆算力，把推理预算集中到难例上更划算。
articles.author: Zhanshuo Cao, Jiakai Tang 等
articles.body: Existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history, regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. Most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. (2) Suboptimality of fixed allocation: given oracle access to the target item, a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one, indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. These observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. To this end, we propose LoopRec. LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. Items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early, while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. This design converts the fixed global depth into a learned, per-item property without auxiliary depth labels, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that LoopRec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. Further analysis reveals that LoopRec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec.
articles.bodyZh: 现在的序列推荐模型（sequential recommenders）通常会给用户交互历史里的每个物品都分配一份固定的计算预算（computational budget），不管这个物品对最终预测到底贡献多大。我们拿两个诊断性发现（diagnostic findings）来挑战这个默认设计。第一，计算需求并不均匀（non-uniform computational need）：同一条序列里的不同物品，需要的计算量差别很大。大多数物品浅层处理一下就收敛了，但有一小撮关键物品非得跑到完整深度（full depth）才稳定。第二，固定分配并不最优（suboptimality）：假设我们能开挂式地直接拿到目标物品的信息（oracle access），那种非均匀深度分配（non-uniform depth assignment）的效果也总是比固定分配更好。这说明现有的统一计算既在已经收敛的物品上浪费容量，又牺牲了整体推荐质量。这些观察让我们想把“固定深度计算”改成“物品级自适应推理（item-level adaptive reasoning）”。为此，我们提出 LoopRec。LoopRec 会递归地复用同一个权重共享模块（weight-shared block），并在每个递归边界加一个轻量门控（gate），对每个物品单独做“退出还是继续”的二选一决策（binary exit-or-continue decision）。表征（representations）已经足够成熟的物品就提前退出，需要更深推理的物品则继续进入下一轮递归。这个设计把固定的全局深度变成了一个学出来的、按物品决定的属性，而且不需要额外深度标签（auxiliary depth labels），也很容易适配不同的骨干架构（backbone architectures）。在公开基准上，我们用四类骨干网络（backbone families）做了大量实验，结果显示 LoopRec 稳定优于同等设置下的固定深度对照模型。进一步分析还发现，LoopRec 学到的分配方式呈现出可解释的规律，而且和我们事后用 oracle 做的分析（post-hoc oracle analysis）对得上：低频物品和更近期的交互，会自然地得到更深计算。我们的代码在 https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec。

articles.title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
articles.zh: PhysiCalWorld：世界模型的上下文内物理校准
articles.summary: 如果你在做世界模型或具身仿真，这篇讲的是不重训模型、直接在上下文里校准物理规律，但要警惕效果高度依赖上下文质量。
articles.author: Yunhao Luo, Wentao He 等
articles.body: Existing world models typically perceive a scene through current visual frame or a narrow history window. However, these observations may not reveal the physics properties that determine transition dynamics, such as an object's mass distribution, joint damping, or surface friction. Without calibrating these physics factors for world models, predictions tend to regress toward an empirical prior and induce severe drift in novel test scenes. To this end, we propose PhysiCalWorld, which calibrates action-conditioned world models to the instance-specific dynamics via in-context prompting, without fine-tuning or analytical physics modeling. Our method encodes an exploratory interaction clip collected within the test scene into a compact physics descriptor token, which grounds subsequent predictions in the scene's actual physical behavior. PhysiCalWorld is trained end-to-end with the latent prediction loss alone, without physics labels. At inference time, the descriptor token is extracted once and can be reused across rollouts with negligible compute overhead. We evaluate PhysiCalWorld across four environments covering diverse physics variations and show that it substantially improves rollout prediction accuracy and visual planning success rate. The learned descriptors also form a physically structured latent space and generalize beyond the physics ranges seen during training.
articles.bodyZh: 现有的世界模型（world models）通常只通过当前这一帧画面，或者一个很窄的历史窗口来理解场景。但这些观察往往揭示不了真正决定状态怎么变化的那些物理属性（physics properties），比如一个物体的质量分布（mass distribution）、关节阻尼（joint damping），或者表面摩擦（surface friction）。如果世界模型不先校准这些物理因素，预测就容易往经验先验（empirical prior）那边靠，在新的测试场景里出现严重漂移（drift）。为此，我们提出了 PhysiCalWorld：它通过上下文提示（in-context prompting），把以动作为条件的世界模型（action-conditioned world models）校准到具体实例的动力学（instance-specific dynamics）上，既不需要微调（fine-tuning），也不需要解析物理建模（analytical physics modeling）。我们的方法会把在测试场景里采集到的一段探索性交互片段（exploratory interaction clip）编码成一个紧凑的物理描述符 token（physics descriptor token），让后续预测扎根在这个场景真实的物理行为上。PhysiCalWorld 只用潜空间预测损失（latent prediction loss）做端到端（end-to-end）训练，不需要物理标签（physics labels）。推理时（at inference time），这个描述符 token 只提取一次，之后在多次推演（rollouts）里都能重复使用，额外计算开销（compute overhead）几乎可以忽略不计。我们在四个环境里评估了 PhysiCalWorld，这些环境覆盖了多种不同的物理变化，结果显示它明显提升了推演预测准确率（rollout prediction accuracy）和视觉规划成功率（visual planning success rate）。学到的描述符还形成了一个具有物理结构的潜空间（physically structured latent space），并且能泛化（generalize）到训练时没见过的物理范围。

articles.title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
articles.zh: 环境对决：LLM协同进化的微缩实验场
articles.summary: 如果你关心多智能体怎么互相博弈、共同变强，这篇用小规模对抗环境复现了协同进化，但结论能否放大到真实规模还得打个问号。
articles.author: Shibo Jin, Zhiqiu Xu 等
articles.body: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.
articles.bodyZh: 在现实世界一连串复杂互动里——从合成训练流水线（synthetic training pipelines）到开放网络（open web）上共享的数据——前沿大语言模型（frontier LLMs）会把前代模型和竞争对手造出来的东西吸收进去。那每个模型在这个生态里，作为“出题者”和“解题者”到底扮演得怎么样？我们推出 Environment Duels，一个动态智能体基准（dynamic agentic benchmark），在交互式环境（interactive environments）里同时考这两种能力。每个模型都会写环境，每个环境都带一个特权提示（privileged hint），目标是做出这样的任务：有能力的解题者（solvers）没提示时做不出来，给了提示就能过。在九个前沿大语言模型上，解题和出题被证明是两种不同的本事：最强的解题者并不是最强的出题者；反倒是小一点的模型，从别人怎么玩里学得更多，还能写出最难的环境和最管用的提示。除了分数，这些两两互动（pairwise interactions）还构成了一个缩影，能看出模型之间怎么互相影响。两两对战的结果具有传递性（transitive），所以能得到一个稳定排名；独立的出题者（authors）会收敛到同样的设计；而在一个用 Qwen3.8-27B 做的强化学习（reinforcement-learning）研究里，学习者在某个出题者环境上的提示增益（hint lift），能对应上“在这些环境上训练”能让它在留出推理和智能体基准（held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks）上提升多少——不管这些环境是它自己写的，还是别的模型写的。每一种模式，在模型于对决之外如何互相塑造这件事上，都有对应的影子。通过在受控条件下把这些互动摆出来，Environment Duels 给了我们一个窗口，去看大语言模型怎么互相教、互相挑战、互相学习。代码在 https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels。

articles.title: The End of Consensus Research?
articles.summary: 如果你习惯靠"圈内都这么说"来判断研究方向，这篇会让你重新掂量共识还有多少参考价值。
articles.author: Clément Burgelin, Rachid Guerraoui 等
articles.body: Consensus is a fundamental problem in distributed computing and at the core of state machine replication (SMR). Despite decades of active human research, discovering practical low-latency solutions to the problem is still open, as it requires combining protocol knowledge, correctness reasoning, implementation, and experimental evaluation. We report on how AI helped us discover A-greement, a new consensus protocol for geo-replicated state machines that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solutions. Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, A-greement reduces the mean latency of a geo-distributed key-value store over the fastest baseline by 12.2% and 33.3% on write-heavy and read-heavy workloads, respectively, and matches the fastest baseline on read-only workloads. A-greement combines lease-authorized local reads, direct client learning for leader-ordered writes, and a fast fixed-quorum per-key write path, selected according to network topology and workload. At the heart of our discovery lies AI-greement, an agent harness for the "autonomous" discovery, implementation, experimentation, and verification of candidate protocols. AI-greement integrates (1) a concept-oriented protocol knowledge base, (2) a modular implementation skeleton, and (3) a Lean-based verification framework with reusable safety definitions, reference specifications, and proofs. AI-greement is of independent interest: its Lean formalization uncovers several previously unreported vulnerabilities in existing consensus protocols, and it provides guidelines on how domain-specific harnesses can turn general-purpose coding agents into effective tools for (distributed) computing research. Yet we argue that human consensus experts remain essential before, during, and after the search: agents reshape the researcher's role rather than end consensus research.
articles.bodyZh: 共识（consensus）是分布式计算里的根本难题，也是状态机复制（state machine replication, SMR）的核心。几十年来人们一直在积极研究，但想找到实用的低延迟方案，这个问题到现在还是开放的，因为它得把协议知识、正确性推理、工程实现和实验评估揉到一起。我们这次要报告的是，AI 是怎么帮我们发现了 A-greement——一个面向地理复制状态机（geo-replicated state machines）的新共识协议，性能明显甩开当前最先进的方案。平均来看，在 6 种部署、每种用 5 个或 9 个副本的情况下，A-greement 让地理分布式键值存储（key-value store）的平均延迟，在写多负载（write-heavy workloads）和读多负载（read-heavy workloads）下，比最快的基线（baseline）分别降低 12.2% 和 33.3%；在纯读负载下则和最快基线持平。A-greement 把几样东西合在一起：租约授权（lease-authorized）的本地读、让客户端直接学习领导者排序的写结果，以及按 key 走的快速固定法定人数（fixed-quorum）写路径；具体选哪套，看网络拓扑（network topology）和负载。我们这次发现的核心，是 AI-greement——一个智能体框架（agent harness），用来“自主”发现、实现、实验和验证候选协议。AI-greement 集成了三块：(1) 面向概念的协议知识库；(2) 模块化的实现骨架；(3) 基于 Lean 的验证框架（Lean-based verification framework），里面有可复用的安全性（safety）定义、参考规范和证明。AI-greement 本身也值得关注：它的 Lean 形式化（Lean formalization）挖出了现有共识协议里好几个以前没报告过的漏洞，也给出了指导——领域专用的框架怎么把通用编程智能体（general-purpose coding agents）变成做（分布式）计算研究的有效工具。不过我们认为，在搜索之前、搜索过程中和搜索之后，人类共识专家仍然必不可少：智能体改变的是研究者的角色，而不是给共识研究画上句号。

articles.title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
articles.zh: Quant-Arena：面向量化交易研究的LLM Agent基准测试
articles.summary: 如果你想让Agent替你做量化研究，先看清这个基准测的是研究流程能力，不是它能不能赚钱。
articles.author: Houde Qian, Zheng Jiang 等
articles.body: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.
articles.bodyZh: 量化研究（quantitative research）其实是个反复打磨的循环：研究员先提出一个市场假设（market hypothesis），把它做成能执行的信号（executable signal），拿历史数据去测，再决定哪些留、哪些扔。现有基准测试（benchmarks）大多只给公式、代码或单笔交易决策打分，所以有个问题一直没答案：大语言模型（LLMs）到底能不能跑通这一整套循环，做出在研究期之外也能用的策略？为此我们推出 Quant-Arena，这是一个基准测试兼公开排行榜（public leaderboard），用来做基于真实A股市场数据（A-share market data）的端到端（end-to-end）量化研究。模型要自己构建特征（features）和股票打分代码（stock-scoring code），但只能在2022到2023年的数据上拿到反馈（feedback），然后锁定一个策略，放到封存的2024年做评估。现金账户评估器（cash-account evaluator）会把交易限制和成本（trading constraints and costs）算进去，包括用模拟订单簿（simulated order book）估算出来的市场冲击（market impact）。评分主要看已实现超额收益（realized excess return），再用信号质量（signal quality）和策略所用特征的多样性（diversity of features）来做补充。我们评测了九个前沿模型（frontier models），其中GPT-6 Astra得分最高；但2024年没有任何一个模型跑赢等权市场（equal-weight market）。Quant-Arena 接受任何模型或智能体运行框架（agent harness）提交结果。

articles.title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
articles.zh: 多模态具身Agent：从计算机操作到机器人操作的能力中心统一视角
articles.summary: 如果你在纠结GUI Agent和机器人Agent是不是两套东西，这篇按能力维度把它们塞进同一个框架里对照。
articles.author: Yanzhe Chen, Ziyi Yang 等
articles.body: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.
articles.bodyZh: 多模态智能体（MMAs）靠推理、记忆、工具和反馈来维持互动，最典型的就是电脑操作类智能体；而机器人系统（RSs）则是在物理动力学约束下，把感知和执行（actuation）结合起来。我们把多模态具身智能体（MMEAs）定义为：能把多模态任务推理和物理动作结合起来，并根据结果反馈修正决策的目标导向系统。这就带出一个核心问题：当一个多模态智能体从“用电脑”转向“用机器人”，到底发生了什么变化？我们提出 PAPAV，一个以能力为中心的统一框架，包含五种反复出现的能力：感知当前状态（Perceive）、预判动作效果（Anticipate）、规划可行路线（Plan）、通过接口或身体执行动作（Act）、验证结果（Verify）。这些能力按功能定义，不按架构定义，因此 PAPAV 能先找出这三类系统共同拥有什么，再拿 MMEAs 分别和 MMAs、RSs 做比较。从部分可观测性（partial observability）到结果难以验证（unverifiable outcomes），这五项物理约束意味着：能提前定死的选择更少，出错后能挽回的余地也更小。在64个基准测试（benchmarks）里，明确的评估主要盯着 Act；只有5个测 Anticipate，3个测 Verify，这两项能力基本都被任务成功率给遮住了。这些约束也框定了我们指出的那些待解挑战。所以，PAPAV 提供了一个共同基础：既能用来设计可靠的物理智能体，也能用来衡量这五项能力到底进步了多少，而不是只盯着任务成功率。

articles.title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration
articles.zh: 非对称同策略蒸馏学习上下文内探索
articles.summary: 如果你在做蒸馏又嫌学生模型太保守，这个非对称设计让它在上下文里自己试错，代价是训练稳定性得盯紧。
articles.author: Sriyash Poddar, Yanda Bao 等
articles.body: Sequential decision-making under partial observability is difficult because agents must explore to infer hidden, task-relevant information before acting effectively. Learning such information-gathering behaviors tabula rasa via online reinforcement learning is sample-inefficient, whereas offline imitation averages expert actions across hidden states and fails to learn exploration. In this work, we propose ASTEROID, a simple and effective student--teacher supervised learning framework that can learn test-time exploration. Although a privileged expert never needs to explore, we demonstrate that a history-conditioned student can learn to do so when trained with on-policy contexts: the student first collects on-policy context under partial observability, and the privileged expert provides action labels conditioned on that context. By distilling expert actions directly conditioned on the student's on-policy history, the student learns to systematically resolve partial observability, i.e., search while uncertain and exploit once the hidden state is revealed. This enables efficient test-time exploration (similar to Bayesian posterior sampling) without incurring the impractical training-data costs of reinforcement learning. Across a diverse range of eleven different environments, including discrete exploration benchmarks, robotic manipulation, navigation, and Procgen environments, ASTEROID achieves ~2x higher returns under fixed exploration budgets, uses ~100x fewer interactions than RL baselines, and outperforms frontier models at exploration. Finally, our method transfers policies trained in simulation to vision-denied real-world robot manipulation, exhibiting efficient exploration and increasing success by +40% over standard distillation. Overall, it provides a simple yet surprisingly effective framework to learn efficient test-time exploration.
articles.bodyZh: 在部分可观测性（partial observability）下做序贯决策很难，因为智能体必须先探索，推断出那些隐藏但和任务相关的信息，才能有效行动。想靠在线强化学习（online reinforcement learning）从零学出这种信息收集行为，样本效率很低；而离线模仿（offline imitation）会把专家在不同隐藏状态下的动作平均起来，根本学不会探索。在这项工作里，我们提出了 ASTEROID，一个简单又有效的学生—教师监督学习框架（student–teacher supervised learning framework），能学会测试时探索（test-time exploration）。虽然拥有特权信息的专家根本不需要探索，但我们证明：只要用同策略上下文（on-policy contexts）来训练，一个以历史为条件的学生模型（history-conditioned student）也能学会探索——学生模型先在部分可观测的情况下收集自己策略产生的上下文，特权专家再根据这个上下文给出动作标签。通过把专家动作直接以学生模型的同策略历史为条件进行蒸馏（distillation），学生模型就能系统性地解决部分可观测问题：不确定时搜索，隐藏状态一旦揭示就利用。这样一来，就能实现高效的测试时探索（类似贝叶斯后验采样，Bayesian posterior sampling），又不用承担强化学习那种不切实际的训练数据成本。在十一种不同环境里，包括离散探索基准、机器人操作、导航和 Procgen 环境，ASTEROID 在固定探索预算下回报约高 2 倍，与强化学习基线（RL baselines）相比交互次数少约 100 倍，探索表现还超过了前沿模型（frontier models）。最后，我们把这个方法从模拟中训练出的策略迁移到没有视觉的真实机器人操作（vision-denied real-world robot manipulation）中，展现出了高效探索，成功率比标准蒸馏（standard distillation）提高了 40%。总的来说，它提供了一个简单却意外有效的框架，用来学习高效的测试时探索。
